parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListHttpRequestHeaderModificationRules](~~2867483~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:
- global: queries global configurations.
- rule: queries rule configurations.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. The default value is version 0.
